subject.title: Dashboard: Living Answers + action-form — the chat↔dashboard loop

question: Should maintainers sponsor this stacked dashboard branch after dependency, SQLite-storage, sandbox, proof, and conflict repairs, or require a narrower replacement after the foundation PRs land?
rationale: The blockers combine product direction, security boundary, dependency authorization, and storage ownership choices that cannot be safely resolved as a routine automated fix.

options.title: Repair before merge
options.body: Require the branch to rebase on the accepted foundation, remove or authorize the dependency graph change, move runtime state to the approved SQLite/plugin state owner, fix sandbox/UI defects, and provide real dashboard proof before review approval.

options.title: Accept with explicit sponsorship
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally sponsor the storage/dependency/security shape, but the PR still needs documented owner approval and proof for the risk it introduces.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Close or pause the PR until the foundation stack lands and re-open the Living Answers/action-form work as a smaller branch against current main.

recommendation.title: Repair before merge
recommendation.body: Require the branch to rebase on the accepted foundation, remove or authorize the dependency graph change, move runtime state to the approved SQLite/plugin state owner, fix sandbox/UI defects, and provide real dashboard proof before review approval.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available current-main routing signal for repository policy and Control UI-adjacent ownership decisions.
